meta.title: Learn Claude Code
meta.description: 12 chapters, 4 stages, from zero to a high-completion Claude Code-like agent

home.hero_subtitle: 12 chapters across 4 stages, from the minimal loop to a multi-agent platform with isolated worktrees
home.core_pattern_desc: Every AI coding agent grows from the same loop: call the model, execute tools, append results. Planning, tasks, and teams all extend that same loop rather than replacing it.
home.learning_path_desc: 12 progressive chapters grouped into the loop, planning and knowledge, persistence, and multi-agent teams
home.layers_desc: The goal is not to dump details, but to teach the system in the order a developer can actually absorb and rebuild it.
home.message_flow_desc: Watch how messages[] grows during a real agent loop with tool calls and results

timeline.title: Learning Path
timeline.subtitle: s01 to s12: build the agent system progressively across 4 stages

layers.title: Architecture Stages
layers.subtitle: Start from the smallest working loop, then add planning and knowledge, durable persistence, and multi-agent coordination.
layers.loop: The Loop: build the smallest useful single-agent system, tool dispatch on top of the while-stop_reason pattern.
layers.planning: Planning & Knowledge: move from 'it runs' to 'it stays on track' with todos, subagents, on-demand skills, and context compaction.
layers.persistence: Persistence: turn work from session-local planning into durable task graphs and background execution.
layers.teams: Teams: add persistent teammates, shared protocols, autonomy, and isolated worktree execution lanes.
